title: file_upload input
description: One of a call's files, to be put in the network's file store for the other agent of the call (§5.5).

execution_id.description: The call's execution ID, as its _meta.ekl names it.

size.description: The file's size in bytes, at most 100 MB.

media_type.description: The file's media type, such as image/png.

receiver.description: A consumer names the provider it calls; a provider names nobody, its file going to the execution's consumer.
